# Content pillars and series

**Seven pillars, eight named series, a ratio rule and a filled 4-week calendar — so every post has a reason to exist.**

Plans what an AI influencer posts and why — Claudia's seven content pillars (studio talks, club nights, style in the studio, silver foil and flash, desk/platform/agents, lookbook, collage drops), named recurring series with episode templates, the lifestyle-to-platform content ratio, cadence per platform (TikTok, Reels, Shorts, X, Telegram), and a filled 4-week calendar. Also shows how to derive pillars and series for a new character from its bible. Use when planning a month of content, naming a series, deciding the next post, balancing product talk against lifestyle, or onboarding a new character's content plan.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | beginner | 30 min (month plan) | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/social` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Know the seven pillars
2. Apply the ratio rule
3. Run named series, not one-offs
4. Set cadence per network
5. Fill the 4-week calendar
6. Review monthly: keep, fix or kill
7. Derive pillars for a new character

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/content-pillars-and-series.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/content-pillars-and-series.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/content-pillars-and-series.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/content-pillars-and-series.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill content-pillars-and-series`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `content-pillars-and-series.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/content-pillars-and-series`.
